summary: Catalog search (CLI products and MCP products_search) must use the credential-aware Algolia client, including CREATIVEFABRICA_BASE_URL / config base_url; import must fail because the public catalog is search-only.
reason: The generated HTTP client has no Algolia application id or search key, so a POST to /1/indexes/*/queries returns 403. Constructing algolia.New without applying config.Load skips the verifier/mock host. Creative Fabrica also has no create/upsert API, so JSONL import cannot write products.
